title: Chapter 486 Meeting The Spirit
content:
Chapter 486 Meeting The Spirit

After Wang Shuo discussed with Zhao Bangde, Zhu Dongheng, Duan Wenxi and others, he conferred titles on all the meritorious officials.

Finally, it was Wang Shuo's wedding.

Wang Shuo wore a bright red dragon robe, holding Ye Xueer, who was wearing a phoenix crown and bridal robe, and walked slowly towards the hall.

The MC said loudly: "The dragon soars thousands of miles and brings auspiciousness, and the phoenix meets the phoenix tree and brings blessings to the earth. The work of heaven and the spirit of earth, look at the peach blossoms today, suitable for the family, and predict that the next year will be prosperous and prosperous... The ceremony is over!"

With the beautiful blessings of the MC, Wang Shuo walked into the hall and began a series of procedures such as worshiping heaven and earth.

...

After the wedding night.

In the early morning, Lord Zack suddenly appeared in front of Wang Shuo.

This made Wang Shuo feel a little unhappy, but he didn't show it.

"How is it, isn't it very cool now!"

Unifying the world and being accompanied by a beauty, of course it's very cool!

Wang Shuo rolled his eyes.

Lord Zach smiled, then said regretfully: "Good things are always short-lived."

"Do you know why you came to this continent?"

Wang Shuo was shocked and almost forgot about it.

But all this is no longer important. Wang Shuo just wants to enjoy his life as an emperor.

Wang Shuo shook his head and said: "It's no longer important."

Lord Zach said seriously: "No, it's very important."

"This continent is actually for selecting some people with strong survival ability to perform a task for Yuanshen."

Wang Shuo laughed and said: "Lord Zach, you are not kidding! Is there anything that God can't do in this world?"

Lord Zach's face sank and warned: "Don't be disrespectful to Lord Yuanshen."

"You have unified the continent, which has proved your strength and you are qualified to meet Yuanshen."

Lord Zach's voice just fell.

Wang Shuo saw the picture in front of him constantly changing.

Appeared in a starry sky.

In the distance, there was a huge phantom that was too big to see the whole picture, standing in the starry sky.

"Soul, old servant Zach, I have found another warrior who can explore the alien world for you."

"Well, very good."

The voice of the soul seemed to come from the void, but it was everywhere.

"Little guy, do you have a lot of question marks?"

Wang Shuo was naturally shocked.

"The vast universe, the brilliant starry sky, civilization is not a lone fire."

"Do we really exist?"

"For the answer to this question, I have been standing on the edge of the universe for a long time!"

The soul paused for a while and continued.

"Although I can create planets with one thought, I found that the universe has boundaries, and this boundary is accelerating away."

"I don't know what is on the other side of the boundary, because I never dare to take this step."

Wang Shuo was confused. You don't dare to take this step, so how can I dare?

Wang Shuo didn't say it, but the soul could hear Wang Shuo's voice.

"So, you need to explore the way for me first."

Without waiting for Wang Shuo to answer.

The spirit said again: "You still have five hundred years. When the time comes, you will step into another universe with other warriors."

After the spirit finished speaking, Wang Shuo returned to the Vana Empire.

When Wang Shuo woke up, he felt like he had a dream, which was a little unreal.

Five hundred years later, Wang Shuo came to this place again. There were other warriors at this time. Over the years, the spirit found a total of 10,000 warriors with strong survival ability.

The spirit waved his hand, and Wang Shuo and others went towards the dimensional barrier.

(The whole book is over)
